california_state_and_local_inheritance.statutory_authority: CA Revenue & Taxation Code §§13301–13302 (enacted via Proposition 6, June 1982; voter approval required to repeal)

prop_13_and_prop_19.prop_13_base_rate: 1.00% + voter-approved local debt & flat parcel charges
prop_13_and_prop_19.prop_19_formula: New Taxable Value = FBYV + max(0, FMV - FBYV - Cap), less $7,000 Homeowners' Exemption if occupied within 1 yr
prop_13_and_prop_19.prop_19_move_out_rule: Moving out later removes the Prop 19 exclusion on the next Jan 1 lien date (BOE Pub. 800-1)

basis_and_capital_gains.revocable_trust_step_up: Full FMV step-up at death under IRC §1014 when included in gross estate
basis_and_capital_gains.irrevocable_trust_trap: NO IRC §1014 step-up for irrevocable grantor trust assets excluded from gross estate (IRS Rev. Rul. 2023-2)
basis_and_capital_gains.california_capital_gains: Taxed as ordinary income: 1% to 12.3% + 1% Mental Health Services Tax over $1,000,000 (13.3% top rate)
basis_and_capital_gains.treasury_interest_ca_exemption: U.S. Treasury obligation interest is 100% exempt from California income tax (31 U.S.C. §3124)
